method: Full source semantic review of the two prepared scripts; no execution, build or main performed by this review.
checked: New destination refuses prior attempts; all source/cache copies are byte checked and root objects are excluded before direct Lean compilation.
Whole-root audit reconstructs qualified axiom/provenance reports, requires unique compiler TOTAL and trio; refresh reconstructs counts from that pinned log and refuses boolean counts/exits.
Source inventory is reconstructed exactly from pinned baseline plus declared bundle modules; functions and embedded kernel bodies remain unchanged in the coverage candidate.
Expectation is measured before the future main, with the old spec/source preserved as history; nonembedded _check_damming.lean exclusion is explicit for the new isolated source tree.
Reused objects remain pinned to prior receipts; direct root audit is distinguished from a full main or seal.
limits: The scripts were prepared and not executed at review time; later receipt and compiler output must satisfy these checks.
This is semantic review, not an OS isolation claim or independent recompilation.
